title: Prejudice in Sub-Saharan Africa: (Why) Is Homophobia Different?

Electric Vehicle Charging in the Workplace: Experimental Evidence on Incentives and Environmental Nudges
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Workplace charging is increasingly important for electric-vehicle (EV) adoption and for managing the grid impacts of transportation electrification, yet workplace networks operate under tight constraints: charging capacity is scarce, parking is bundled with chargers, and employers are reluctant to ask drivers to move vehicles during the workday. As a result, workplaces often rely on other policy tools (e.g., light-touch information and time-invariant price discounts) whose effects may differ from home or public charging settings. We study these policies in a natural field experiment with 629 EV drivers on a large university campus charging network. We randomize (i) informational emails emphasizing the environmental benefits of daytime charging and (ii) time-invariant discounts for workplace charging. Environmental nudges shift charging initiation modestly from early morning to later morning hours but do not increase total workplace charging. In contrast, price discounts increase total workplace charging but shift charging toward early-morning and evening periods when network utilization is lower. A followup experiment shows that perceived charger scarcity is a key mechanism shaping these timing responses, alongside congestion, charger reliability, and driver characteristics. We also translate the behavioral responses into illustrative emissions impacts and fiscal abatement costs.
abstract_zh: 随着电动汽车（EV）的普及以及交通电气化对电网的影响日益凸显，工作场所充电的重要性与日俱增。然而，工作场所充电网络受到严格约束：充电容量稀缺，停车位与充电桩捆绑在一起，雇主也不愿要求司机在工作日中途挪动车辆。因此，工作场所往往依赖其他政策工具（例如轻度的信息提供和不随时间变化的价格折扣），而这些工具的效果可能不同于家庭或公共充电场景。我们在一个大型大学校园充电网络中，通过一项自然现场实验研究了这些政策，实验对象为629名电动汽车司机。我们对以下两方面进行了随机化：(i) 强调日间充电环境效益的信息性邮件，以及 (ii) 不随时间变化的工作场所充电折扣。环境助推使充电起始时间从清晨略微推迟至上午晚些时候，但并未增加工作场所充电总量。相反，价格折扣增加了工作场所充电总量，但使充电时段转向清晨和傍晚，而这些时段的网络利用率较低。后续实验表明，感知到的充电桩稀缺性是影响这些时间选择反应的关键机制，此外还包括拥挤程度、充电桩可靠性以及司机特征。我们还将这些行为反应转化为示意性的排放影响和财政减排成本。

title: Energy Conservation under Repeated Contracts and Contests
Fostering Cooperation: The Conflict-Reducing Effects of Inter-village Competition for Government Transfers

Scaling Low-Cost Digital Interventions: Lessons from an Energy Conservation Experiment
Can Social Protection Reduce Environmental Damages?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Why do damages from changes in environmental quality differ across and within countries? Causal investigation of this question has been challenging because differences may stem from heterogeneity in cumulative exposure or differences in socioeconomic factors such as income. We revisit the temperature-violence relationship and show that cash transfers attenuate one-half to two-thirds of the effects of higher same-day temperatures on homicides. Our results not only demonstrate causally that income can explain much of the heterogeneity in the marginal effects of higher temperatures, but also imply that social protection programs can help the poor adapt to rising temperatures.
abstract_zh: 为什么环境质量变化造成的损害在不同国家之间以及同一国家内部存在差异？对这一问题进行因果研究一直颇具挑战，因为这些差异可能源于累积暴露的异质性，也可能源于收入等社会经济因素的差异。我们重新审视了气温与暴力之间的关系，并证明现金转移支付可以削弱当日较高气温对凶杀案影响的二分之一至三分之二。我们的结果不仅从因果角度证明，收入可以解释气温边际效应异质性的很大一部分，还表明社会保障计划有助于穷人适应气温上升。

title: Heat and Team Production: Experimental Evidence from Bangladesh
abstract: Heat's impact on economic growth and aggregate productivity is well-established, but while individual impairments are well-understood as mechanisms, the role of interpersonal dynamics remain unexplored despite the growing prevalence of team-based occupations. In our experiment, programmers were randomly assigned to work individually or in pairs under warm (29°C) or control (24°C) conditions. We found that heat had no effect on individual performance but impaired team performance—not through decreased effort but likely through impaired collaboration. This negative impact was strongest in heterogeneous teams, suggesting heat exacerbates coordination challenges, confirmed by poorer partner evaluations in warm conditions.
abstract_zh: 高温对经济增长和总体生产率的影响已得到充分证实，但尽管个体损伤作为一种机制已得到充分理解，人际互动的作用仍未得到探讨，而以团队为基础的职业却日益普遍。在我们的实验中，程序员被随机分配为单独工作或两人结对工作，并处于温暖（29°C）或对照（24°C）条件下。我们发现，高温对个人绩效没有影响，但损害了团队绩效——原因并非努力程度下降，而很可能是协作受到损害。这种负面影响在异质性团队中最为强烈，表明高温加剧了协调挑战，并且在温暖条件下伙伴评价的下降也证实了这一点。

A Comparison of Contests and Contracts to Deliver Cost-Effective Energy Conservation
Air Purifiers in Bangladeshi Firms
Going Viral: Public Attention and Environmental Action in the Amazon
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: International agreements to reduce anthropogenic environmental disasters rely on public pressure to drive local action. We study whether focused media and increased public attention can drive local environmental action, reducing environmental damage. Although an annual affair, forest fires in the Brazilian Amazon went viral in August 2019, receiving unprecedented public scrutiny. Comparing active fires in Brazil versus those in Peru and Bolivia in a difference-in-differences design, we find that increased public attention reduced fires by 22%, avoiding 24.8 million tons of CO2 in emissions. Our results highlight the power of public attention to compel local action on pressing environmental issues.
abstract_zh: 旨在减少人为环境灾害的国际协定依赖公众压力来推动地方行动。我们研究了聚焦的媒体报道和增加的公众关注能否推动地方环境行动，从而减少环境损害。尽管巴西亚马逊地区的森林火灾每年都会发生，但在2019年8月，这一事件引起了空前的公众关注，迅速走红。我们在双重差分设计中，将巴西与秘鲁和玻利维亚的活跃火点进行对比，发现公众关注的增加使火灾减少了22%，避免了2480万吨二氧化碳排放。我们的研究结果凸显了公众关注在推动地方采取行动应对紧迫环境问题方面的力量。

title: Rural Roads, Farm Labor Exits and Crop Fires
abstract: Even as policymakers seek to encourage economic development by addressing misallocation due to frictions in labor markets, the associated production externalities—such as air pollution—remain unexplored. Using a regression discontinuity design, we show access to rural roads increases agricultural fires and particulate emissions. Farm labor exits are a likely mechanism: rural roads cause movement of workers out of agriculture and induce farmers to use fire—a labor-saving but polluting technology—to clear agricultural residue or to make harvesting less labor-intensive. Overall, the adoption of fires due to rural roads increases infant mortality rates by 5.5 percent in downwind locations. (JEL D62, J43, O13, O18, Q12, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 即便政策制定者力图通过解决劳动力市场摩擦所导致的资源错配来促进经济发展，相关的生产外部性（如空气污染）仍未得到探讨。利用断点回归设计，我们发现农村道路的通达性会增加农业火灾和颗粒物排放。农业劳动力流出是一个可能的机制：农村道路促使工人离开农业，并促使农民使用火烧——一种节省劳动力但会造成污染的技术——来清理农业残留物，或使收割更省力。总体而言，由于农村道路而采用火烧，使下风向地区的婴儿死亡率上升了5.5%。（JEL D62, J43, O13, O18, Q12, Q51, Q53）

title: Residential Air Purifiers and the Value of Clean Air
Agricultural Productivity and Deforestation
The Ecological Impact of Place-Based Economic Policies
abstract: Does economic development have an unavoidable ecological cost? We examine the ecological impacts of one of India's signature place-based economic policies involving massive tax benefits for new industrial and infrastructure development following the creation of the new state of Uttarakhand. The policy, which had an explicit pro-environment mandate, resulted in no meaningful change in local forest cover. Our results suggest that even in settings with low levels of enforcement, place-based economic policies with pro-environment mandates can achieve sizeable economic expansion without major ecological costs.
abstract_zh: 经济发展是否不可避免地带来生态代价？我们考察了印度标志性的地方性经济政策之一的生态影响，该政策在乌塔拉卡汉德邦（Uttarakhand）这一新邦设立后，为新的工业和基础设施开发提供了大规模税收优惠。该政策明确带有保护环境的使命，但其结果是地方森林覆盖没有出现实质性变化。我们的结果表明，即使在执法水平较低的环境中，带有环境保护使命的地方性经济政策也可以在不造成重大生态代价的情况下实现可观的经济扩张。

title: Warming from Tropical Deforestation Reduces Worker Productivity in Rural Communities
abstract: The accelerating loss of tropical forests in the 21st century has eliminated cooling services provided by trees in low latitude countries. Cooling services can protect rural communities and outdoor workers with little adaptive capacity from adverse heat exposure, which is expected to increase with climate change. Yet little is still known about whether cooling services can mitigate negative impacts of heat on labor productivity among rural outdoor workers. Through a field experiment in Indonesia, we show that worker productivity was 8.22% lower in deforested relative to forested settings, where wet bulb globe temperatures were, on average, 2.84 °C higher in deforested settings. We demonstrate that productivity losses are driven by behavioral adaptations in the form of increased number of work breaks, and provide evidence that suggests breaks are in part driven by awareness of heat effects on work. Our results indicate that the cooling services from forests have the potential for increasing resilience and adaptive capacity to local warming.
abstract_zh: 二十一世纪热带森林的加速损失，已使低纬度国家树木所提供的降温服务消失。降温服务可以保护那些适应能力较弱的农村社区和户外工作者免受高温的不利影响，而随着气候变化，这种高温暴露预计还会增加。然而，关于降温服务能否减轻高温对农村户外工作者劳动生产率的负面影响，目前仍知之甚少。通过在印度尼西亚开展的一项实地实验，我们发现，在森林砍伐地区，工人的生产率比有森林地区低8.22%，而森林砍伐地区的湿球黑球温度平均高出2.84 °C。我们证明，生产率损失是由行为适应所驱动的，表现为工作中休息次数的增加；并提供证据表明，这些休息在一定程度上是由工人对高温影响工作的认识所驱动的。我们的研究结果表明，森林提供的降温服务有可能提高当地应对气候变暖的韧性和适应能力。

title: Extreme Temperatures and Time-Use in China
venue: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: How do people in developing countries respond to extreme temperatures? Using individual-level panel data over two decades and relying on plausibly exogenous variation in weather, we estimate how extreme temperatures affect time use in China. Extreme temperatures reduce time spent working, and this effect is largest for female farmers. Hot days reduce time spent by women on outdoor chores, but we find no such effects for men. Finally, hot days dramatically reduce time spent on childcare, reflecting large effects on home production. Taken together, our results suggest time use is an important margin of response to extreme temperatures.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的人们如何应对极端气温？利用二十年间的个体层面面板数据，并依托气候条件中看似外生的变化，我们估计了极端气温如何影响中国人的时间使用。极端气温减少了工作时间，且这一效应在女性农民中最为显著。炎热的日子减少了妇女用于户外家务劳动的时间，但对男性则没有此类影响。最后，炎热的日子大幅减少了照料儿童的时间，这反映出对家庭生产的重大影响。综合来看，我们的结果表明，时间使用是应对极端气温的一个重要调整渠道。

title: Heat Exposure from Tropical Deforestation Decreases Cognitive Performance of Rural Workers: An Experimental Study
abstract: The effect of tropical deforestation on heat exposure and subsequent human health outcomes remains understudied, especially among an increasingly vulnerable population—healthy, adult subsistence workers in rural industrializing tropical countries. We report on a field experiment that estimated the short-term effects of heat exposure from deforestation on cognitive performance. We randomly assigned rural, adult subsistence workers in East Kalimantan, Indonesia to deforested or forested settings, and standard or high incentive piece rate payments. Participants worked in forested or deforested settings for up to 90 min, where ambient and black globe temperatures in deforested areas were, on average, 2.1 °C and 10 °C higher. After completing the experimental task, participants were asked to take a validated general cognitive assessment test (CAT) and episodic memory test (EMT). We found participants in deforested settings had statistically significant lower scores on both CAT and EMT. Effects were largely driven by heat effects on male participants and those working after noon. Our results highlight how heat exposure from tropical deforestation may lead to declines in cognitive performance even in favorable work settings. Policymakers should consider how land use planning that takes into account the cooling services of trees can play a significant role in increasing resilience to heat from climate and land use change in the tropics.
abstract_zh: 热带森林砍伐对热暴露及随后人类健康结局的影响仍未得到充分研究，尤其是在日益脆弱的人群中——即在快速工业化的热带发展中国家中，健康的成年自给农业劳动者。我们报告了一项实地实验，估计了森林砍伐所致热暴露对认知表现的短期影响。我们将印度尼西亚东加里曼丹的农村成年自给农业劳动者随机分配到森林砍伐或有森林的环境中，并分别给予标准或高激励计件工资。参与者在森林或森林砍伐环境中工作最长达90分钟，其中森林砍伐地区的环境温度和黑球温度平均分别高出2.1 °C和10 °C。完成实验任务后，参与者接受了经过验证的一般认知评估测试（CAT）和情景记忆测试（EMT）。我们发现，身处森林砍伐环境中的参与者，其CAT和EMT得分均显著更低。这些影响主要由男性参与者以及午后工作的参与者所驱动。我们的研究结果凸显了，即使在较为有利的工作环境中，热带森林砍伐导致的热暴露也可能导致认知表现下降。政策制定者应考虑，将树木的降温服务纳入土地利用规划，这在提高热带地区应对气候和土地利用变化所致高温的韧性方面可以发挥重要作用。

title: Temperature and Human Capital in India
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We estimate the effects of temperature on human capital production in India. We show that high temperatures reduce math and reading test scores among school-age children. Agricultural income is one mechanism driving this relationship—hot days during the growing season reduce agricultural yields and test scores with comparatively modest effects of hot days in the nongrowing season. The roll-out of a workfare program, by providing a safety net for the poor, substantially weakens the link between temperature and test scores. Our results imply that absent social protection programs, higher temperatures will have large negative impacts on human capital production of poor populations in agrarian economies.
abstract_zh: 我们估计了气温对印度人力资本形成的影响。研究表明，高温降低了学龄儿童的数学和阅读考试成绩。农业收入是驱动这一关系的一个机制：生长季的高温日会降低农业产量并拉低考试成绩，而非生长季高温日的影响相对较小。一项工作福利计划的推广，通过为穷人提供社会安全网，显著削弱了气温与考试成绩之间的联系。我们的结果表明，若缺乏社会保障计划，气温升高将对农业经济体中贫困人口的人力资本形成产生巨大的负面影响。

title: The Ecological Impact of Transportation Infrastructure
abstract: There is a long-standing debate over whether new roads unavoidably lead to environmental damage, especially forest loss, but causal identification has been elusive. Using multiple causal identification strategies, we study the construction of new rural roads to over 100,000 villages and the upgrading of 10,000 kilometers of national highways in India. The new rural roads had precisely zero effect on local deforestation. In contrast, the highway upgrades caused substantial forest loss, which appears to be driven by increased timber demand along the transportation corridors. In terms of forests, last mile connectivity had a negligible environmental cost, while expansion of major corridors had important environmental impacts.
abstract_zh: 关于新建道路是否必然导致环境破坏，特别是森林损失，学界存在长期争论，但因果识别一直难以实现。我们利用多种因果识别策略，研究了印度向超过10万个村庄修建新农村道路以及将1万公里国道升级改造的情况。新建农村道路对当地森林砍伐的影响恰好为零。相比之下，国道升级造成了大量森林损失，这似乎是由沿交通走廊增加的木材需求所驱动的。就森林而言，“最后一公里”连通的环境成本可以忽略不计，而主要走廊的扩张则产生了重要的环境影响。

title: Ecosystems and Human Health: The Local Benefits of Forest Cover in Indonesia
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: (Not So) Gently Down the Stream: River Pollution and Health in Indonesia
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Waterborne diseases, often arising from freshwater pollution, are a leading cause of mortality in developing countries. However, data limitations inhibit our understanding of the extent of damage arising from freshwater pollution. We employ a novel hydrological approach combined with village census data to study the effect of upstream polluting behavior on downstream health in Indonesia. We find that upstream use of rivers for bathing and associated sanitary practices can explain as many as 7.5% of all diarrhea-related deaths annually. We also find suggestive evidence for differential avoidance behavior in response to different pollutants. Our approach relies on publicly available satellite data, open source hydrological models, and coarse village census data allowing us to estimate health externalities from river pollution in particularly vulnerable and data poor environments.
abstract_zh: 水传播疾病通常源于淡水污染，是发展中国家的主要死亡原因之一。然而，数据限制妨碍了我们对淡水污染所致危害程度的理解。我们结合村庄人口普查数据，采用一种新颖的水文学方法，研究印度尼西亚上游污染行为对下游健康的影响。我们发现，上游居民在河流中沐浴及相关卫生习惯，每年可解释多达7.5%的腹泻相关死亡。我们还发现了一些初步证据，表明人们针对不同污染物会采取不同的回避行为。我们的方法依赖于公开可得的卫星数据、开源水文模型以及粗略的村庄人口普查数据，使我们能够在特别脆弱且数据匮乏的环境中估计河流污染的健康外部性。

title: Emissions Reductions or Green Booms? The General Equilibrium Effects of a Renewable Portfolio Standard
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Well-Being Dynamics and Poverty Traps
abstract: A sound understanding of poverty traps—defined as poverty that is self-reinforcing due to the poor's equilibrium behaviors—and their underlying mechanisms is fundamentally important to the development of policies and interventions targeted to assist the poor. We review the theoretical and empirical evidence on single equilibrium and multiple equilibria poverty traps at the macro-, meso-, and, especially, microlevels. In addition we review the literature exploring the various mechanisms that have been posited to perpetuate poverty. We find sufficient evidence to support the poverty traps hypothesis, suggesting that policies designed to interrupt those self-perpetuating mechanisms merit serious attention.

title: Market Prices and Food Aid Local and Regional Procurement and Distribution: A Multi-Country Analysis
